local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local expected=nil
local done=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 local corpse=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x15985a))
 if not corpse or not corpse:isValid() then return end
 local source=Actor.inventory(corpse)
 local player=Actor.inventory(self)
 if not expected then
  expected={{}}
  for _,item in ipairs(source:getAll()) do
   local id=item.recordId
   expected[id]=player:countOf(id)+source:countOf(id)
   local record=item.type.record and item.type.record(item)
   print('Sewer corpse item '..id..' count '..source:countOf(id)..' name '..(record and record.name or '?'))
  end
  print('Sewer loot observer ready dead='..tostring(Actor.isDead(corpse)))
 end
 if done then return end
 local n=0
 for id,count in pairs(expected) do
  n=n+1
  if source:countOf(id)~=0 or player:countOf(id)~=count then return end
 end
 if n>0 then done=true print('Sewer corpse loot transferred types='..n) end
end}}}}
